line: Crowley's Princess of Wands: the Hé final of the Name, the earthy part of Fire, and one quadrant of the heavens about the North Pole.

sections.title: The court and its element
sections.line: Crowley names the Princesses by the Hé final of the Name.

quotes.quote: The Princesses represent the Hé final of the Name.
The Princess of Wands represents the earthy part of Fire; one might say, she is the fuel of Fire.

sections.title: Its place in the heavens
sections.line: Princesses have no zodiacal attribution. The text gives her one quadrant of the heavens around the North Pole, and the attribution table gives the same (pdf p274).

quotes.quote: The Princesses have no Zodiacal attribution.
She rules the Heavens for one quadrant of the portion around the North Pole.

sections.title: Its character as Crowley describes it
sections.line: Crowley's description of the figure and the card, in his own words.

quotes.quote: The character of the Princess is extremely individual.
